title: Manasukkul Mathappu
desc: A man is shattered and loses his sanity after the woman he loves dies. In the mental asylum, his doctor falls in love with him, but her father is against their union.

title: Kanden Seethaiyai
desc: In a bid to pay for her husband's expensive operation, a woman accepts an unusual proposition to become a surrogate mother for a wealthy couple. However, problems begin to crop up in her life.

title: Kai Kodukkum Kai
desc: Kaalimuthu marries Seetha, a woman whose vision is impaired, much to the disappointment of his family. But, disaster strikes when he shelters a man in their house without knowing his true agenda.

title: Military
desc: Madhavan is known as Military due to his strict attitude towards his five sisters. However, when he is forced to get his first sister married to a widowed professor, his other sisters alienate him.

title: Guntur Kaaram
desc: The son of a politician seeks answers after growing up, from his mother, who during his childhood, asks him to sign documents denying they are related.
